brief: The canvas presents a deeply atmospheric, cold alpine winter landscape, featuring snow-draped peaks and muted, icy color palettes. The foreground is dominated by detailed rock formations etched with natural channels. The scene subtly moves with an ongoing sense of atmosphere, such as drifting snow or changing light. When the viewer clicks, an avalanche occurs, depositing debris and fresh snow that has settled specifically within the natural channels and crevices of the foreground rock formations, creating visible, sculpted snow drifts.

statement: This sketch creates an atmospheric winter landscape with layered geological formations and drifting snow. The scene features rocky terrain etched with natural channels that respond to user interaction through a triggered avalanche effect. The viewer experiences subtle environmental motion through camera movement and snow physics, while clicking produces a localized avalanche that deposits fresh snow specifically within the crevices of foreground rocks. The technique uses WEBGL rendering for depth perception, procedural generation for terrain elements, and particle systems for atmospheric snowfall that responds to both time-based animation and user input events.
